name: fw-setup
description: Installs and manages Freshworks Development Kit (FDK) with Node.js 24 via nvm. Slash: /fw-setup-install (--version), /fw-setup-upgrade (--to), /fw-setup-downgrade, /fw-setup-uninstall, /fw-setup-status (--verbose), /fw-setup-troubleshoot (--fix), /fw-setup-use (workspace nvm stack). Legacy: /fdk-install, etc.

interface.shortDescription: Install and manage FDK with Node.js via nvm.
interface.longDescription: Shell Tasks and inline commands for FDK 10 on Node 24, optional FDK 9 on Node 18, uninstall, status, troubleshoot --fix, and workspace nvm/.nvmrc. Legacy /fdk-* slash aliases where registered.

commands.name: fw-setup-install
commands.description: Install FDK 10 + Node 24; optional --version X.Y.Z (CDN pin)

commands.name: fw-setup-upgrade
commands.description: Upgrade FDK; optional --to X.Y.Z semver (CDN vX.Y.Z.tgz)

commands.name: fw-setup-downgrade
commands.description: Downgrade FDK 10 → 9; optional semver 9.x.y or latest 9 line

commands.name: fw-setup-use
commands.description: Workspace stack: nvm use + .nvmrc (10/9); optional --write-nvmrc; inline only
